ALTER PROC [DW].[SP_DW_FACTCARDSCREDITLIMIT] @Businessdate [VARCHAR](10) AS
BEGIN


WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] A
      --JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,LIMITTYPEID, MAX(TIMESTAMP) TIMESTAMP, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD' GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,LIMITTYPEID, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SOURCESYSTEMCODE) B
      --  ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.LIMITTYPEID = B.LIMITTYPEID AND A.TIMESTAMP = B.TIMESTAMP AND A.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = B.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND A.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = B.SOURCESYSTEMCODE
      WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        select * from DW.FactCardsCreditLimit b
        where CONVERT(VARCHAR,A.TIMESTAMP,112) = b.[BusinessDateSK]
        and A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = b.AccountId
        )
      AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'  
)

INSERT INTO DW.FactCardsCreditLimit
(
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,PermanentCreditLimit
,CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

SELECT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SUM(PermanentCreditLimit) PermanentCreditLimit
,SUM(CurrentCreditLimit) CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM (
SELECT 
 @businessdate AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Permanent Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0)  ELSE NULL END AS PermanentCreditLimit
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0)  ELSE NULL END AS CurrentCreditLimit
,BCL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm                                                                                          
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCL
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPaymentCard] BCP ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[PaymentCard] BPC ON BPC.PaymentCardId = BCP.PaymentCardId

) A
where not exists (
    select * from DW.FactCardsCreditLimit b
    where 
    A.BusinessDateSK = b.[BusinessDateSK]
    and A.AccountId = b.AccountId   
)
GROUP BY
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
END

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'factcardscreditlimit_Balance') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE dw.factcardscreditlimit_Balance;
END;

WITH 
CustomerAccountLimit
AS(
      SELECT * FROM [BNKM].[CustomerAccountLimit] WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)
,Balance AS (
SELECT
 BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SUM(PermanentCreditLimit) PermanentCreditLimit
,SUM(CurrentCreditLimit) CurrentCreditLimit
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM (
SELECT 
 CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCL.[TIMESTAMP],112) AS BusinessDateSK
,DDB.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,DDBK.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDA.AccountSK AS AccountSK
,DDA.AccountId AS AccountId
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Permanent Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0) ELSE 0 END AS PermanentCreditLimit
,CASE WHEN BCL.LimitTypeId = 'Credit Limit' THEN ISNULL(LimitAmount,0) ELSE 0 END AS CurrentCreditLimit
,BCL.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,Getdate() AS InsertDttm                                                                                          
FROM 
CustomerAccountLimit BCL
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccount] BCA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCA.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBranch] DDB ON BCA.BranchId = DDB.BranchID AND DDB.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimBank] DDBK ON BCL.FinancialInstitutionId = DDBK.BankID
LEFT JOIN [DW].[DimAccount] DDA ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = DDA.AccountID AND DDA.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[CustomerAccountPaymentCard] BCP ON BCL.CustomerAccountId = BCP.CustomerAccountId
LEFT JOIN [BNKM].[PaymentCard] BPC ON BPC.PaymentCardId = BCP.PaymentCardId
) A
GROUP BY
BusinessDateSK
,BranchSK
,BankSK
,AccountSK
,AccountId
,SourceSystemCode
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
)

select * into dw.factcardscreditlimit_Balance from Balance;

with source_tbl as (
select * from dw.factcardscreditlimit_Balance a
where not exists 
(select * from dw.factcardscreditlimit b 
    where 
    a.BusinessDateSK = b.BusinessDateSK
    and isnull(a.BranchSK,0) = isnull(b.BranchSK,0)
    and a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    and a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    and a.AccountId = b.AccountId
    and a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
    and a.WorkFlowId = b.WorkFlowId
    and a.TaskRunId = b.TaskRunId)
) 
, target_tbl as (
select * from dw.factcardscreditlimit a 
where not EXISTS
(select * from dw.factcardscreditlimit_Balance b
    where 
    a.BusinessDateSK = b.BusinessDateSK
    and isnull(a.BranchSK,0) = isnull(b.BranchSK,0)
    and a.BankSK = b.BankSK
    and a.AccountSK = b.AccountSK
    and a.AccountId = b.AccountId
    and a.SourceSystemCode = b.SourceSystemCode
    and a.WorkFlowId = b.WorkFlowId
    and a.TaskRunId = b.TaskRunId)
    )


--select * from target_tbl

select 'Source' as tables, count(1) cnt from source_tbl
UNION ALL
select 'Target' as tables, count(1) cnt from target_tbl where businessdatesk <> '20230601'
